    • Method Detail

      • isUpdateCapable

        public boolean isUpdateCapable()
        Description copied from class: DataObjectBinding

        Test to see if this DataObjectBinding object is capable of pushing an object into a ResultSet with the DataObjectBinding.marshall(java.lang.Object, java.sql.ResultSet) method. If this method returns false then it can be assumed that any call to marshal will result in an UnsupportedOperationException.

        By default this method returns true, and so should be overridden by implementors that cannot update a ResultSet.

        Overrides:
        isUpdateCapable in class DataObjectBinding<T>
        Returns:
        true if invoking the marshal will not result in an UnsupportedOperationException

      • marshall

        public void marshall(T from,
                     ResultSet results)
              throws UnsupportedOperationException
        Description copied from class: DataObjectBinding
        Marshall a specified object into a ResultSet. This method should only be used if a call to DataObjectBinding.isUpdateCapable() returns true. This method will attempt to place the fields of the given object into the specified ResultSet. The ResultSet given here should be in the same format as the one given to DataObjectBinding.unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet), failure to do so can result in an EoDException.
        Specified by:
        marshall in class DataObjectBinding<T>
        Parameters:
        from - the object to marshall
        results - the ResultSet who's columns are to be set
        Throws:
        UnsupportedOperationException
